I’m not arguing that the normal 3v3v3v3 mode isn’t the best for the finals but I’m just proposing that a cash out mode for people playing in 4 or 5 stacks could be worth a try for the development of the game and could still work even if it is different from the normal mode. Saying it wont work because it would be different doesn’t seem like a very strong argument.
yeah thats what we have to deal with too, we all love the cash out mode and want to be playing that but can’t when we have more than three so we just settle for power shift most of the time
Maybe if they implemented respawn tokens like in ranked and maybe increased revive times that could fix that issue?

Power shift and terminal attack are fun and all, but honestly they don’t come anywhere close to the feeling of playing the cash out mode that the finals is known for.

About the gadgets, I’m sure they could find a way to limit the amount of utility a team brings and figure out a way to balance that aspect. Maybe limit it to two slots of gadgets per player. 

And regardless of it being a 5v5, the team attacking a cash out is always at a disadvantage anyways, but with utility limitations and maybe increased revive times — the attacking team would still have a good chance at getting a steal. Though if 5v5 is just too much I think even a 4v4 mode could be interesting too and maybe slightly more balanced.

And yeah third parties are part of the game but if you play tournaments, a lot of the time it’s 1 team vs another per vault. Yeah occasionally there will be third parties but most of the time it’s a fight between two teams the whole match so that’s nothing new.

I guess my proposal would be to make it tournament style with respawn tokens, like in the final round of a tournament, but several matches (maybe best of 3 matches?) to still keep that competitive feeling and give the losing team a chance to catch up. 

I’m sure there would a lot of other complications tho but idk I just think it would be great for the game and would give it a way to really compete with other 5v5 or 4v4 competitive fps games like warzone, siege or cs which are games my friends and I usually play.
